'''Thulwuk Thur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who worked as a [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]] in the [[Morjanssik Mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents traveled to Mon Calamari to investigate some acts of sabotage that had been carried out by a group of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] infiltrators. The agents decided to travel down to the [[Mining/Legends|mine]] and they accompanied Thur and a group of [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] miners during a trip in a [[Transport Bathysphere/Personnel|transport bathysphere]] from the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Morjanssik]] to the mine.
